notes.title: Dark Age Dinos - Spring Update
notes.content:
Spring is in the air! Our team has emerged from hibernation bearing a new demo update for you all to enjoy over your spring breaks. Once again this update is just too large to give an exhaustive list, but here are some of the headlines:

[list]
[*] Cretacia’s shopkeepers got an extra large order of healing flasks recently and they’re practically giving them away. You can now buy back used flasks from any shop
[*] A local shopkeeper recently got a killer deal on some property behind the demo’s miniboss. There will always be a shop after the miniboss on the map
[*] Speaking of the miniboss, they spent the winter learning how to keep warm. Be on your guard for a new meteor attack
[*] The Dinosaur Combat Union has ratified an agreement to add more space between tiles. It’s never been easier to tell where your foe begins and your ally ends
[*] Everybody must have been parched before those flasks. You’ll find your party and the demo’s boss are much more talkative these days
[/list]

Of course, that’s not all we’ve been working on. Internally, our full launch roster has been finalized and playtesters have been loving the new character classes. We can’t wait to share them with you all soon (TM). In the meantime, here’s a little teaser:

notes.title: Demo V0.4 Is Live Now!
notes.content:
Hey Dark Age Dinos fans! The v0.4 demo update goes live TODAY!

Our team has been loving hearing all of your feedback since our Demo launched in August. You’ve laughed, you’ve cried, you’ve raged and most of all - you’ve been having a blast!

The quality of our updates relies on honest feedback from our players, so keep it up. We want to hear how v0.4 feels to you.

While you’ve been quaffing flasks, we’ve been hard at work improving the core of the game and adding some much-requested quality of life improvements. This update is so massive that a full changelog would be unwieldy, so instead, check out a summary of the major changes below:

[list]
[*][b]Undo Movement:[/b] You can now undo previous moves to overcome misclicks or targeting mishaps. Once you use an Action, that movement is set in stone though!
[*][b]Pass Through Allies:[/b] Allied characters can walk past each other to help line up that awesome shot.
[*][b]Enemy Rebalance:[/b] Reduced the number of enemies in most encounters, but made some of the enemies that appear later in the run more unique and challenging.
[*][b]Shoot Over Stuff:[/b] You can target most actions over short obstacles, like bushes and rocks.
[*][b]Destructible Obstacles:[/b] If something taller is in your path, you can break it!
[*][b]Change Attack Order:[/b] Change who attacks when in between battles.
[*][b]Share Money:[/b] Gold can now be handed back and forth between characters. No more fighting over who has to buy [i]The Sandwich[/i].
[*][b]Explosive Barrels:[/b] We couldn’t consider ourselves a real video game without these. They’ve been carefully placed in several battle maps to cause maximum chaos. Some all new battle maps have been added as well, so be sure to keep an eye out.
[/list]

Thank you to everybody that’s played the demo, left feedback or featured us in gameplay videos or social posts.

And for those of you that haven’t tried Dark Age Dinos before, there’s never been a better time to jump in and let us know what you think.

We’ll see you in v0.4!
